startup_prompts: Set a minimal starting groove — simple kick, snare, closed hi-hat, and a short two-bar bass line. Keep it clean and leave space to evolve.
Lay down a foundation — four on the floor kick, tight snare on 2 and 4, closed hi-hats, simple bass hook. Something to build on.
Start from scratch with a basic groove — kick, snare, hat, and a one-bar bass line. Raw and simple.
Open up with a sparse beat — kick every bar, a snare crack, hi-hat pulse, and a minimal bass riff. Leave room to breathe.
